title: Frontend Developer Intern - React/Tailwind
shortDescription: Join our core UI engineering team to build scalable, accessible interfaces. You'll be working directly with senior designers and engineers on high-impact user-facing features using modern React patterns.
fullDescription:
Join our core UI engineering team to build scalable, accessible interfaces. You'll be working directly with senior designers and engineers on high-impact user-facing features using modern React patterns.

Master the fundamentals of modern frontend engineering in this hands-on internship. Designed for aspiring developers, this program covers the entire UI development lifecycle — from component architecture and accessibility standards to performance optimization and design-system integration. You will build a real portfolio piece through direct contributions to a production codebase.
learningOutcomes: Build reusable React component libraries
Apply Tailwind CSS utility-first styling patterns
Implement accessible, WCAG-compliant UI
Collaborate using Git in a team environment

title: UX/UI Foundations Bootcamp
shortDescription: An intensive 8-week program covering user research, wireframing, high-fidelity design, and prototyping. Perfect for beginners looking to transition into product design roles.
fullDescription:
An intensive 8-week program covering user research, wireframing, high-fidelity design, and prototyping. Perfect for beginners looking to transition into product design roles.

Master the fundamentals in this intensive program. Designed for aspiring professionals, this program covers the entire lifecycle — from research to high-fidelity prototyping and testing. You will build a comprehensive portfolio piece through hands-on, real-world project simulations.
learningOutcomes: Conduct user interviews and analyze qualitative data
Create structural layouts and user flows
Apply typography, color theory, and visual hierarchy
Build interactive, testable prototypes in Figma

title: Junior Cloud Architect Intern
shortDescription: Assist in designing and deploying cloud infrastructure using AWS and Terraform. You will shadow senior architects and participate in optimizing CI/CD pipelines for enterprise clients.
fullDescription:
Assist in designing and deploying cloud infrastructure using AWS and Terraform. You will shadow senior architects and participate in optimizing CI/CD pipelines for enterprise clients.

Gain hands-on experience with enterprise-grade cloud architecture in this hybrid internship. You will work alongside senior engineers on real infrastructure projects — provisioning environments, writing Terraform modules, and contributing to automated deployment pipelines that serve thousands of users.
learningOutcomes: Provision and manage AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS)
Write reusable Terraform infrastructure modules
Configure and optimize CI/CD pipelines
Apply cloud security and IAM best practices

title: Full Stack Web Development
shortDescription: Learn to build complete web applications from scratch using Node.js, Express, and React.
fullDescription:
Learn to build complete web applications from scratch using Node.js, Express, and React.

This comprehensive program takes you from zero to full-stack developer. You will build and deploy multiple real-world projects covering both client-side and server-side development — including REST API design, database integration, authentication, and cloud deployment. Ideal for learners who want a complete, job-ready skill set.
learningOutcomes: Build and deploy REST APIs with Node.js and Express
Develop dynamic frontends with React and hooks
Integrate SQL and NoSQL databases
Deploy full-stack apps to cloud platforms

title: Data Science Intern
shortDescription: Join our AI team to build predictive models and analyze large datasets using Python and TensorFlow.
fullDescription:
Join our AI team to build predictive models and analyze large datasets using Python and TensorFlow.

Work alongside data scientists and ML engineers on real business problems. You will clean and explore large datasets, train and evaluate machine learning models, and present findings to stakeholders. This internship is ideal for learners with a foundation in Python who want practical, portfolio-ready ML experience.
learningOutcomes: Explore and clean real-world datasets with pandas
Train and evaluate ML models with scikit-learn and TensorFlow
Visualize data insights with matplotlib and seaborn
Communicate findings through structured reports
